description: End-to-end validation suite for self-improving orchestrator

hints.json_parse_failed: Enable UNIFIED_STRIP_FENCES=1 or tighten prompts to emit bare JSON.
hints.schema_task_id_mismatch: Add explicit task_id echo to prompt or relax schema.
hints.dependencies_not_met: Check upstream task failures; consider retry/backoff policy.
hints.task_not_found: Use inject_missing_tasks.py to create missing task files.
hints.timeout_exceeded: Consider reducing parallelism or increasing task timeout.
hints.provider_rate_limited: Implement exponential backoff or switch providers.
